verdict.rationale: DPMA offers patent and trade mark databases (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister) and e-filing routes. A service like this could plausibly offer recurring scheduled searches or monitoring alerts, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents any capability to schedule recurring jobs, workflows or automated watches. The robots.txt probe concerns crawling permissions only and says nothing about scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
